==About==

A Yellow Morel is a Poisonous Mushroom which can be found in the wild or, with the [[Fungiculture]] Skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Yellow Morel}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting a Yellow Morel there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Yellow Morel can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.

When boiled a Yellow Morel will become a {{i|Boiled Yellow Morel}}. Both a Boiled Yellow Morel and a Yellow Morel count as a Yellow Morel when planting and in Food recipes.
